name: Why is it important to properly seal siding around doors?

mainEntity.name: Why is it important to properly seal siding around doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Properly sealing siding around doors is crucial for preventing water intrusion, which can lead to costly damage like rot, mold growth, and compromised structural integrity. A good seal also improves your home's energy efficiency by reducing drafts and air leaks, contributing to a more comfortable indoor environment and lower utility bills. This protective barrier helps maintain the longevity of both your siding and door frames.
acceptedAnswer.description: Properly sealing siding around doors prevents water damage, mold, and improves energy efficiency by stopping drafts and air leaks.
